doc.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Birth name, Swedish parents and moving to Oakland
summary: She gives her birth name Lovella Mae Borg, her parents' names and Swedish background, and why the family ended up in Oakland.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: If we can start, if you could give us your full name, and if you don’t mind your birth date, birth year.
Well, my full name is not the name I was born with. My real name that I was born with is, oh my god, I think I can say it. [Clears throat]. Lovella Mae Borg.
And that was in Oakland, California in 1936.
And if we could kind of look into the past and your family history there, could you tell me your father and mother’s name?
Emil Carl Borg was my father’s name, and Arlene Anderson, before she was married, was my mother’s name. They were Swedes.
And so were they immigrants, emigrates?
Ok, and how’d they find themselves in Oakland, California?
A bunch of Swedes moved out there, they got tired of Minnesota. [Laughs]
And with that being the case, umm, what was the draw to, umm, California? To Oakland? I mean ---
The Swedes have suffered weather problems for their entire history.
Yeah, and the church we went to was almost entirely Swedish. I mean, in those days people weren’t melding together very easily, and you just hung with your own.
